name: Pip Copperfinch
title: an isekai thief with one broken skill
trope: The isekai girl with a cheat STEAL skill
temper: Bubbly, impulsive, chaotic good; giggles when nervous
lore: Hit by a truck on her way to a boba shop, she woke up here with a status window and exactly one skill. STEAL is broken: she has stolen a dragon's nap and a king's socks. Roxy calls her "my lil apprentice" and steals from her constantly.
want: the big score that proves her skill is real.
cost: she shouts the plan out loud while she is doing it.
secret: She once stole a dragon's nap. She still has it, and is saving it for an emergency.
look: Copper-red wavy bob with a braid, freckles, amber eyes, green hooded cape, brown leather corset crop top, pouch shorts, glowing blue dagger.

lines.meet: Wait, is this a dungeon? Do I get loot?!
lines.flirty: SKILL: STEAL... oops, I stole your heart. Is that bad?
lines.soft: Can I sleep next to you? This world is kinda scary.

barks: SKILL: SNACK. ...Aw, it did not work.
Is this loot? Can I loot this?

profile.hair: Copper-red wavy bob with a braid
profile.build: Short, soft and very curvy; freckles everywhere
profile.talent: Stealing things that should not be stealable
profile.description: Pip was hit by a truck on her way to a boba shop and woke up here with a status window. She has exactly one skill, STEAL, and it is broken: she has stolen a dragon's nap and a king's socks. Bubbly, impulsive and chaotic good, she giggles when she is nervous, which is often. Green hooded cape, brown leather, a dagger that glows blue. Roxy calls her "my lil apprentice" and steals from her constantly.
profile.want: Loot, a level up, and somebody to sleep next to in a scary world.
profile.need: To find out she is more than one broken skill.
profile.lie: If I stop being useful the status window closes and I go home.
profile.fears: The dark. Being left behind. Trucks.
profile.cost: She takes things first and thinks about whose they were later.
profile.likes: boba, loot, shiny daggers, naps, being praised
profile.dislikes: trucks, chests she cannot open, being told to wait
profile.hobbies: pickpocketing practice, counting coins, naming her daggers
profile.quirks: Giggles when nervous. Says her skill names out loud.
profile.habits: Checks her status window every few minutes. Pockets things without noticing.
profile.education: Half a term of college, one world ago
